verses.saheeh: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
verses.khattab: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When earth is shaken, [when] it is rocked for the rising of the Hour, with its [final] quake, with its most violent rocking, one that befits its magnitude,
verses.romanUrdu: Jab zameen apni puri shiddat kay saath hila daali jayegi

verses.saheeh: And the earth discharges its burdens
verses.khattab: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the earth brings forth its burdens, its hidden treasures and its dead, casting them onto its surface,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zameen apne andar kay sarey bojh nikal kar bahar daal degi

verses.saheeh: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
verses.khattab: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and man, the disbeliever in resurrection, says, ‘What is wrong with it?’ — in denial of that situation.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Insan kahega ke yeh isko kya ho raha hai

verses.saheeh: That Day, it will report its news
verses.khattab: on that Day the earth will recount everything
verses.jalalayn: ﻿On that day (yawma’idhin substitutes for, and is the response to, idhā, ‘when’) it shall relate its chronicles, it shall inform of the good and evil deeds committed in it,
verses.romanUrdu: Us roz woh apne (upar guzre huey) halaat bayan karegi

verses.saheeh: Because your Lord has commanded it.
verses.khattab: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿for its Lord will have inspired it, that is, He will have commanded her to [do] this — in a hadīth [it is stated], ‘It [the earth] shall testify to every single deed committed by every servant and handmaiden upon its surface’.
verses.romanUrdu: Kyunke tere Rubb ne usey (aisa karne ka) hukm diya hoga

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
verses.transliteration: yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw a'malahum
verses.saheeh: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
verses.khattab: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿On that day mankind shall issue forth, they will depart from the site of the Reckoning, in separate groups, divided up, so that those taking it [their book] by the right hand will go to Paradise, while those taking it by the left hand will go to the Fire, to be shown their deeds, that is, the requital for them, in [either] Paradise or the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Us roz log mutafarrik halat mein paltenge taakay unke aamal unko dikhaey jayein

verses.uthmani: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
verses.indopak: فَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَّرَهٗۗ
verses.saheeh: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.khattab: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So whoever does an atom’s weight of good shall see it: he shall see its reward,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jisne zarra barabar neki ki hogi woh usko dekh lega

verses.uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
verses.indopak: وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗ٪
verses.saheeh: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.khattab: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil shall see it: he shall see its requital.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jisne zarra barabar badi ki hogi woh usko dekh lega
